facts.text: Eastern University is a Christ-centered community preparing graduates to impact the world through faith, reason, and justice.

sources.title: About Eastern University
sources.quote: Mission: Eastern University is a diverse, Christ-centered community preparing graduates to impact the world through faith, reason, and justice.

facts.text: Eastern University offers LifeFlex programs designed with online formats and flexibly-paced courses.

sources.title: LifeFlex Programs - Eastern University
sources.quote: With online formats, flexibly-paced courses, and incredibly affordable prices, these LifeFlex programs promise to flex when life doesn't.
